meta.promptText: Which face wash should I buy for oily skin in India under ₹500?

response.text:
For oily skin under ₹500 in India, the best choice depends on whether your skin is prone to **acne and blackheads** or if it's **sensitive and easily irritated**.

The top dermatologist-backed and budget-friendly face washes available in India fit well within your budget:

---

### 1. Best for Oily & Acne-Prone Skin (Pores, Blackheads, Breakouts)

* **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid + LHA Cleanser**
  *   * **Price:** Around ₹299 (100 ml)[skintold.in](https://skintold.in/best-face-wash-for-oily-skin-in-india/#:~:text=Approx.%20Price%3A%20%E2%82%B9299%20%28100%20ml%29)
  * **Key Ingredients:** 2% Salicylic Acid, LHA, and Zinc PCA
  * **Why buy it:** Salicylic acid dives deep into pores to dissolve trapped sebum and clear out dead skin cells.[skintold.in](https://skintold.in/best-face-wash-for-oily-skin-in-india/#:~:text=Salicylic%20acid%20is%20one%20of%20the%20most,salicylic%20acid%20can%20be%20an%20excellent%20choice.) The added Zinc helps regulate sebum production throughout the day without stripping your skin dry.[skintold.in](https://skintold.in/best-face-wash-for-oily-skin-in-india/#:~:text=Zinc%20PCA%20helps%20regulate%20sebum%20production%20and,combined%20with%20salicylic%20acid%20in%20acne-focused%20cleansers.) It is fragrance-free and non-comedogenic.[skintold.in](https://skintold.in/best-face-wash-for-oily-skin-in-india/#:~:text=Pros%20*%20Excellent%20for%20oily%20and%20acne-prone,excess%20oil%20without%20making%20skin%20feel%20tight.)
  * *Alternative:* **The Derma Co 1% or 2% Salicylic Acid Gel Face Wash** (~₹299–₹349) or **Foxtale Oil & Acne Control Face Wash** (~₹329).[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/skin/cleansers/face-wash/c/8379#:~:text=The%20Face%20Shop.%20Rice%20Water%20Bright%20Foaming,Acid%20%26%202%25%20Niacinamide.%20%E2%82%B9249%E2%82%B92327%25%20Off.%20CeraVe.)

### 2. Best for Daily Gentle Cleansing (Oily yet Sensitive Skin)

* **Cetaphil Oily Skin Cleanser**
  *   * **Price:** Around ₹380–₹430 (Smaller sizes often retail under ₹350–₹400)
  * **Key Ingredients:** Gentle cleansing agents, Niacinamide, and Glycerin[deyga.in](https://deyga.in/blogs/news/top-10-face-wash-in-india#:~:text=Key%20Ingredients%3A%20Glycerin%2C%20panthenol%2C%20niacinamide.%20Texture%3A%20Creamy,many%2C%20because%20of%20the%20gentle%20cleansing%20effect.)
  * **Why buy it:** If harsh acne cleansers make your skin feel tight, red, or irritated, this is the gold standard. It is a low-foaming, soap-free gel that removes up to 99% of excess oil while completely protecting your skin barrier.[www.aliteskincare.in](https://www.aliteskincare.in/blogs/skin-care/best-face-wash-for-oily-skin-in-india-2026#:~:text=This%20sulphate%20free%20face%20wash%20for%20oily,for%20T-zone%20oiliness%20does%20not%20cause%20tightness.)

### 3. Best Budget All-Rounder (Daily Freshness & Oil Control)

* **Plum Green Tea Pore Cleansing Face Wash[deyga.in](https://deyga.in/blogs/news/top-10-face-wash-in-india#:~:text=The%20vitamin%20blended%20formulation%20along%20with%20glycerin,Face%20Wash.%20Cost%3A%20%E2%82%B9360%20%2F%20150%20ml.)**
  *   * **Price:** Around ₹360 (150 ml)[deyga.in](https://deyga.in/blogs/news/top-10-face-wash-in-india#:~:text=The%20vitamin%20blended%20formulation%20along%20with%20glycerin,Face%20Wash.%20Cost%3A%20%E2%82%B9360%20%2F%20150%20ml.)
  * **Key Ingredients:** Green Tea Extracts, Glycolic Acid, and Glycerin[deyga.in](https://deyga.in/blogs/news/top-10-face-wash-in-india#:~:text=The%20hypo-allergic%20formulation%20works%20as%20an%20everyday,excess%20oil%20and%20impurities%20from%20the%20skin.)
  * **Why buy it:** Green tea acts as an antioxidant to calm inflammation, while a mild touch of Glycolic Acid gently exfoliates dead skin cells to prevent clogged pores.[deyga.in](https://deyga.in/blogs/news/top-10-face-wash-in-india#:~:text=The%20green%20tea%20formulation%20which%20is%20rich,texture.%20What%20Makes%20It%20a%20Good%20Choice%3F) It leaves the skin feeling clean and matte without an overly tight after-feel.
  * *Alternative:* **Simple Kind to Skin Refreshing Facial Wash** (~₹325–₹349) for a completely soap-free, ultra-gentle gel experience.

---

### Quick Buying Guide:

* Choose **Minimalist** if you deal with active pimples, whiteheads, and stubborn T-zone oiliness.
* Choose **Cetaphil** if your skin is sensitive, easily reactive, or stings with active ingredients.
* Choose **Plum** if you want a refreshing, antioxidant-rich daily wash that handles mild acne and oil.[deyga.in](https://deyga.in/blogs/news/top-10-face-wash-in-india#:~:text=The%20hypo-allergic%20formulation%20works%20as%20an%20everyday,excess%20oil%20and%20impurities%20from%20the%20skin.)

Do you experience frequent breakouts with your oily skin, or is excess shine your main concern?
